title: Responsive grid with zero media queries
why_it_matters: One line gives you a layout that adapts from phone to desktop.
explanation: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) tells the grid: make as many columns as fit, each at least 220px, and stretch them to fill the row. On a phone you get one column. On a laptop you get four. No breakpoints needed.
try_it: Change 220px to 160px and watch how many columns appear on your phone.
